gloss_en: The Scriptural phrase (Deut. 33:18) "Rejoice, Zebulun, in your going out" (שְׂמַח זְבוּלוּן בְּצֵאתֶךָ) — the blessing of the tribe of Zebulun, invoked as the archetype of engaging in commerce/business dealings (masa u-matan, the 'going out') in holiness, and hence as the emblem of the rectification of the craving for money
